name: WAservixObjC
summary: WAservix WhatsApp API Gateway: official Objective-C client by Tekservix
description: WAservix WhatsApp API Gateway: official Objective-C client by Tekservix. Send WhatsApp text, images, documents and locations from your own number, check message status, manage contacts and groups and verify webhooks. No dependencies beyond Foundation. Requires a Tekservix account with WAservix.
